name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press
steps: Sit tall on a bench with feet planted flat and your core braced.
Hold a dumbbell beside each shoulder with palms facing forward and forearms vertical.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms extend without clanking them together.
Lower both dumbbells slowly under control back to shoulder level.
tips: Keep your elbows slightly in front of your torso at the bottom.
Keep your lower ribs down instead of arching your lower back as you press.
